name: Roast Butternut, Biltong and Brown Rice Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 small butternut squash, peeled and chopped
3 tbsp onion roasted seeds (or plain roasted seeds)
2 tbsp fresh chopped parsley or mint

steps: Cook brown rice according to packet instructions.
Toss butternut, olive oil and seasoning into a roasting pan.
Roast butternut until cooked through and slightly charred.
Stir through rice, butternut, bilton, roasted seeds, cucumber, feta and herbs.
Serve tossed with your favourite vinaigrette, or honey mustard dressing.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
